description: Implement several improvements to the AI models page in the dashboard to enhance user experience and functionality. These changes should include navigation updates, access control refinements, and presentation improvements for the models listing.
functional_requirements: Update the side navigation menu to properly reflect access to the AI models section based on user permissions
Enhance the models index page with improved data presentation and filtering capabilities
Refine access control logic for AI models to ensure proper permission checking across the application
Update environment configuration to support new AI models features
Improve the individual model detail page with better error handling and data display
Ensure all changes maintain backward compatibility with existing functionality
